entities.summary: Bernard de Dryver is a racing driver from Belgium. He was born in Brussels. He entered two World Championship Formula One Grands Prix, the Belgian Grand Prix in 1977 and 1978. In 1977, he entered a non-works March, but failed to make the grid. The following year, he entered a privately run Ensign but did not qualify for official practice.
